look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Alternate pinnate leaves with many paired narrow leaflets; large unequal yellow petals and dark stamens; narrow flattened legume. Check petiolar nectar gland in a future macro.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Branching annual legume with slender stems; whole-plant photo needed.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Alternate pinnate leaves with paired narrow leaflets; petiolar extrafloral nectary needs macro.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Unequal bright yellow petals and dark stamens, rather than flower color alone.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Long flattened legumes that split at maturity, releasing multiple seeds.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Slender branching stems and stipules; closeup needed.
